name: Quick Coming Soon
author: emtiaz51921

sections.description:
Quick coming soon is only for those who need to put a simple note on the site immediately while upgrade or maintenance.

Main Features

  • Lightweight
  • Easy installation.
  • Can put simple note
  • Responsive
  • Background image change
  • Social Button (Facebook,Twitter,Youtube)
sections.installation:
Installing this plugin as regular wordpress plugin.

After install, you can see a menu, settings > Quick coming soon settings. You can change settings form here.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • First Release

1.1

  • Added new features like background image change, add social buttons

1.1.1

  • Add Translation
  • Update to latest version

2.0

  • Update to latest WordPress version 4.9.8

2.0.4

  • Bug fix & Update to latest WordPress version 5.7.2

3.0.0

  • Security: Fixed XSS vulnerabilities — all user-facing values now properly escaped with esc_html(), esc_url(), and esc_attr()
  • Security: Settings page access restricted to Administrators only (manage_options capability)
  • Compatibility: Removed create_function() call — now fully compatible with PHP 8.0+
  • Compatibility: Tested and confirmed working with WordPress 6.7 and PHP 8.2
  • Styles: Modernized stylesheet using CSS custom properties, fluid typography with clamp(), and flexbox layout

3.1.0

  • Bug fix & Update to latest WordPress version 6.9
